what: OA-10 (governance). The hold-merge alarm (JC-CA-04) has NEVER delivered a ping. GitHub does not trigger workflows (system-actions, `issues: opened`) from GITHUB_TOKEN-created events. Example: #16201 (alarm for #16183) is still open with 0 comments; system-actions always comments and closes. Sub-agent count: 174 alarm issues 09-28..10-04, 171 open and unprocessed, 3 closed as moot. r4-demotion-gate and exit-cell-mandate use secrets.BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN for their ping and are unaffected. NOT applied: the alarm counts only GitHub APPROVED reviews and none of 128 held PRs has one, so turning delivery on pages the operator for every manager merge (all 84 Tier-2/3 holds since 09-28). Whether to deliver as-is, or teach the alarm to accept the recorded approvals (checklist quote / PR body / mandate), is the operator's call; policy is not changed here.
